# Pinnacle Odds API

> Pinnacle retired its public API in July 2025. pinnodds is the independent replacement: the same live and prematch market data, pushed to your code over WebSocket and SSE instead of polled, with instant alerts the moment a price drops against its own recent history. Full line depth on every plan — quarter lines, player props and futures included.

This is a paid API service. Get a free trial key in seconds at https://pinnodds.com/ — no card, no email verification, your API key is your login.

Every new key is free forever on the free tier: REST at 20 requests/minute, 100 per day, full line depth, all 12 sports. No card required. A 3-day full demo — REST at 10 requests/second with no daily cap, plus SSE drop streams and the raw WebSocket feed — is available on request; ask on Telegram at t.me/ArbitrageXpro with the email on your key. Paid plans start at $99/mo.

## Common questions

**Is there still a public Pinnacle API?**
No — Pinnacle closed it in July 2025. pinnodds serves the same market data through its own REST, SSE and WebSocket endpoints. You need a pinnodds key, not a Pinnacle account.

**How do I get Pinnacle odds in Python?**
`pip install pinnodds`, then:
```python
from pinnodds import Client
api = Client("YOUR_KEY")
board = api.markets(sport_id=1)          # live soccer
for d in api.stream_drops(min_drop=5):   # real-time drop alerts
    print(d["home"], d["from_price"], "->", d["to_price"])
```

**How do I get Pinnacle odds in JavaScript / Node?**
`npm install pinnodds`, then:
```js
import { Client, SPORTS } from "pinnodds";
const api = new Client("YOUR_KEY");
const board = await api.markets({ sportId: SPORTS.soccer });
for await (const d of api.streamDrops({ minDrop: 5 })) { /* pushed alerts */ }
```

**Can Claude / Cursor / Codex use it directly?**
Yes. pinnodds runs a remote MCP server at https://mcp.pinnodds.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Authenticate with your API key as a Bearer token: `claude mcp add --transport http pinnodds https://mcp.pinnodds.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $PINNODDS_KEY"`. Tools: list_sports, get_events, get_event_odds, get_prematch_lines, get_odds_drops, get_feed_status, get_account_usage, search_pinnodds_docs. claude.ai users add it as a custom connector (OAuth, approve once with your key). Setup for every client: https://pinnodds.com/docs#mcp

**How fresh are the odds?**
Pushed in real time — the feed rides Pinnacle's own push channel rather than a polling loop, so a price change reaches you as it happens. For REST, `since` cursors return only what changed between calls.

**Does it include quarter lines and player props?**
Yes. Soccer totals at 1.75 / 2.25 / 2.75 / 3.25 and quarter-ball handicaps come through on every plan. Player props, exact scores and futures arrive as their own event rows when you pass `include_specials=1`, each linked to its fixture by `parent_id`.

**What's the difference between the SSE alerts and /api/drops?**
Same events, different shapes. An SSE alert names the market in `sect`, the selection in `outcome`, prices in `from_price`/`to_price`, and carries `limit` (Pinnacle's max stake) and `nvp` (no-vig price) — but no drop percentage. A REST `/api/drops` row is the enriched form: `market`, `designation`, `from`/`to`, plus a precomputed `drop_pct`.

## REST endpoints

Auth: `x-api-key: YOUR_KEY` header (also accepted: `x-portal-apikey`) or `?key=YOUR_KEY` query parameter.

- [GET /kit/v1/markets](https://pinnodds.com/docs#markets): Live or prematch markets for a sport. Pass `event_type=prematch` to switch feeds; defaults to live. `include_specials=1` adds props/futures rows.
- [GET /kit/v1/details](https://pinnodds.com/docs#details): Single event by event_id (live store)
- [GET /kit/v1/prematch/fixtures](https://pinnodds.com/docs#prematch-fixtures): All prematch fixtures for a sport with full markets envelope
- [GET /kit/v1/prematch/markets](https://pinnodds.com/docs#prematch-markets): Markets for one prematch event by event_id
- [GET /kit/v1/prematch/lines](https://pinnodds.com/docs#prematch-lines): Compact line view for one prematch event
- [GET /api/drops](https://pinnodds.com/docs#api-drops): Queryable buffer of recent dropping odds. Pass `mode=live|prematch`. Note: always send `max_age_sec` (e.g. 3600) — the official clients do this for you.
- [GET /health](https://pinnodds.com/docs#health): Service status, returns event counts and SSE client counts
- [GET /ping](https://pinnodds.com/docs#ping): Public liveness probe, no auth required

## SSE push streams

Auth: `?key=YOUR_API_KEY` (paid plan with SSE).

- [SSE /odds-drop](https://pinnodds.com/docs#sse-live): Push stream of live odds drops the instant they fire. Optional `?min_drop=N` picks the drop threshold (default 5%, floor 1%). **Cap: 1 connection per account** — opening a 2nd evicts the 1st.
- [SSE /odds-drop-prematch](https://pinnodds.com/docs#sse-prematch): Push stream of prematch odds drops. Optional `?min_drop=N` and `?recheck=N` (hold N seconds + re-verify to filter blips). Counted independently from the live stream — one of each runs in parallel.

## WebSocket raw feed

- [WSS /ws/feed](https://pinnodds.com/docs#ws-feed): The raw upstream feed as a WebSocket passthrough — every frame forwarded verbatim, with per-sport subscriptions. Available as an add-on; see docs for the protocol and example clients.

## Reference data

- [Sport IDs](https://pinnodds.com/docs#sport-ids): Soccer=1, Tennis=2, Basketball=3, Hockey=4, Football=5, Baseball=6, Rugby=7, MMA=8, Boxing=9, Other=10 (Volleyball+Handball combined), Esports=11, Golf=12 (moneyline-only), Cricket=13, Volleyball=14, Handball=15 (14/15 are narrower views of 10, REST only)
- [Market types](https://pinnodds.com/docs#market-types): money_line, spreads, totals, team_total
- [Event response shape](https://pinnodds.com/docs#event-shape): periods.num_0 (full match), num_1 (1st half), num_2 (2nd half), etc.
- [Live game-state object](https://pinnodds.com/docs#live-state): `state` field on live events with in-game data (Soccer: score/redCards/minutes; Basketball: scoreByQuarter/quarter/timeRemainingInQtr; Tennis: setsWon/gamesBySet/points/serving). REST only — not on SSE.
- [Player props & specials](https://pinnodds.com/docs#specials): `include_specials=1` on /kit/v1/markets or /kit/v1/prematch/fixtures adds special-market events (Player Props, Team Props, Exact Scores, futures). Each special is its own event row linked to the parent match by `parent_id`, described by `special` and `special_category`, with named-outcome decimal prices under `special_markets`. Off by default. Specials do not fire SSE drop alerts.
- [Affiliate program](https://pinnodds.com/docs#affiliate): Every account gets a unique `?ref=<code>` link visible in the dashboard. Refer paying customers, earn 30% of every payment lifetime. Manual payouts at $50+ unpaid balance.
- [Rate limits](https://pinnodds.com/docs#ratelimits): Trial 100/day; Stream 100/day; Pro 10 req/sec; Pro+SSE 10 req/sec; Scale 30 req/sec

## Plans

- Trial: free, 100 reqs/day, no SSE
- Stream: $99/mo, drops-only SSE, REST limited
- Pro: $99/mo, REST 10 req/sec, no SSE
- Pro+SSE: $149/mo, REST 10 req/sec + SSE drops bundle (best value)
- Scale: $229/mo, REST 30 req/sec + SSE
